$comment: Research (domain/research/spec.md). Era costs, rates and seats are placeholders from the research tree and country stats v3 section 7. Inventions are the 174 rows of the tree (research-tree.md), one config row each. The 13 past inventions of eras A and M come first (RSCH-092); start groups decide each map nation's knowledge at the start (RSCH-098). Era I runs from the start (1378 at the earliest) to 1500; `starts` holds what differs for a start other than 11 November 1444 (RSCH-114), and `era_pace` paces Era I to the start (RSCH-113).

era_pace.$comment: Era I pacing (RSCH-113): Era I's cost per invention is multiplied by (the year Era II begins - the campaign's start year) / reference_years, never below 1. A 1444 start is x1, a 1378 start about x2.18. Provisional: the balance model tunes it.

1378.$comment: The 20 September 1378 start (plan-1378 section 3.2, D-RSCH-23). Applied only to a campaign that starts in 1378, on top of start_groups, start_add and start_remove. join puts a realm in a group for this start, ids not yet on the map included (each is checked once it is a map nation); add and remove change a realm's set for this start.
